extras: Our kindergarten implements a school-based curriculum: “Project-Approach Learning,” where the learning themes relate to daily life. Through exploration, observation, experience, sharing, and data collection, our students construct knowledge, develop skills, and establish good habits and positive moral values. Field trips are organised for every project theme, and at the end of each project, the children’s learning outcomes are showcased. Our school’s mission is to nurture children with the spirit of Christ’s care, emphasising the development of their spiritual and moral education. schools.name: The International Montessori School - An Imef School

extras: Each IMS classroom is led by a team of two, an English-speaking and a Putonghua-speaking teacher, and is carefully designed to give children opportunities to engage in meaningful learning with the proper balance of autonomy and guidance. Activities in the bilingual Foundations Groups (ages 2-3) encourage toddlers to explore creatively, in a cosy, language-rich and highly interactive environment – the best preparation for learning. The Casa dei Bambini programme (ages 3-6) supports children in moving towards a mastery of self and the environment. The IMS elementary programme (ages 6-12) encourages children to learn all subjects from many directions through all disciplines by taking full advantage of their developing capacity to reason. IMS Middle School is Hong Kong’s only Montessori programme for adolescents aged 12–14. Its bilingual, multi-age environment combines inquiry and project-based learning, tailored to support this transformative stage of development. IMS graduates successfully stream into top international secondary schools in Hong Kong and around the world, with enhanced academic and social skills, and a very strong foundation in both Chinese and English. Mid-Levels Campus (ages 2-6) has 3 bright Casa dei Bambini classrooms, a large play area, a children’s kitchen, a library and a vertical garden where our youngest children enjoy their first years in our school! We also have a lovely environment for toddlers to experience their first taste of Montessori in our Foundation Groups (ages 2-3).
